html:
Trees use nested [value,left,right] lists; an empty subtree is None. Given an integer target, return whether any root-to-leaf path sums to target. An empty tree has no qualifying path, even for target 0.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      4,
      [
        1,
        null,
        null
      ],
      [
        3,
        null,
        null
      ]
    ],
    7
  ],
  "expected": true
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      4,
      [
        1,
        null,
        null
      ],
      null
    ],
    4
  ],
  "expected": false
}
Hint

Only test completion at a leaf.

Complexity: O(n) time, O(h) recursion space

489 explicit tests pass across the 160 original exercises
